contentDefinitions.name: Стеклянная поверхность впадины
contentDefinitions.description: На дне чаши камень отражает свет после дождя. Причина блеска неясна.

discoveryDefinitions.title: Road without a destination
discoveryDefinitions.question: What abandoned route once crossed the eastern heights?

summaries.trace: The old road continues beyond the settled paths.
summaries.hypothesis: The road may belong to infrastructure older than the city.
summaries.discovered: Repeated traces support an abandoned route rather than a natural track.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: Cut stones and a regular grade mark an older route.

discoveryDefinitions.title: Echoes of an older culture
discoveryDefinitions.question: Were the ruins built by one older tradition?

summaries.trace: The stonework repeats a pattern you have seen before.
summaries.hypothesis: The ruins may share a building tradition with distant works.
summaries.discovered: Independent observations support a shared older building tradition.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: Masonry joints and alignments repeat across the ruin.

discoveryDefinitions.title: The old forest line
discoveryDefinitions.question: Did the forest once reach farther into the valley?

summaries.trace: The vegetation changes along a strangely regular boundary.
summaries.hypothesis: The boundary may record climate change or older land use.
summaries.discovered: Independent traces support a former forest line without choosing its cause.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: Soil and vegetation change beyond the present forest edge.

discoveryDefinitions.title: A scar in the stone
discoveryDefinitions.question: Was the eastern site damaged by conflict?

summaries.trace: One masonry layer is darker and more damaged than the rest.
summaries.hypothesis: The damage may have followed a violent event, but fire and weather remain possible.
summaries.discovered: Repeated evidence supports a damaged layer while leaving its cause unresolved.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: A darkened masonry layer interrupts the older stonework.

discoveryDefinitions.title: Блеск Стеклянной впадины
discoveryDefinitions.question: Почему поверхность впадины отражает свет?

summaries.trace: На дне чаши камень блестит после дождя.
summaries.hypothesis: Поверхность ведёт себя не как обычный камень.
summaries.discovered: Повторные осмотры подтверждают особое отражение, но не объясняют происхождение впадины.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: Свет отражается от гладкого слоя; происхождение слоя остаётся неизвестным.

discoveryDefinitions.title: The river remembers another course
discoveryDefinitions.question: Did the river once run through a different channel?

summaries.trace: Dry cuts remain beside the present river.
summaries.hypothesis: The basin may preserve an older course.
summaries.discovered: Independent water traces support a former channel without fixing its cause.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: Sediment and a dry channel suggest water once moved here.

discoveryDefinitions.title: Водопады питают реку
discoveryDefinitions.question: Связаны ли потоки на западных утёсах с уровнем реки?

summaries.trace: Ты увидел потоки, падающие с западных утёсов.
summaries.hypothesis: Похоже, водопады связаны с руслом реки.
summaries.discovered: Ты собрал повторные наблюдения: водопады остаются частью речного бассейна.

discoveryDefinitions.evidenceText: С уступа падают несколько потоков; внизу слышно движение воды.
